d:
The 76ers defeated the Nets, 135-123 tonight in Brooklyn. Joel Embiid finished with a team-high 37 points along with 5 rebounds and 2 three pointers for the 76ers, while Jaylen Brown tallied 31 points, 13 rebounds and 4 assists in the game. Julius Randle recorded 33 points, 6 rebounds and 2 steals. The 76ers improve their record to 12-3 with the win, while the Nets fall to 3-10 for the season.
